crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

translations.web: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
translations.bsb: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
translations.kjv: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess
translations.asv: And Jehovah commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
